annotate_fx_proxy: annotate an fx.Proxy value with a type during tracing and return the value
annotate_regular_value: annotate a regular non-Proxy value and return it unchanged
annotate_check_existing_type: annotate an fx.Proxy that already has a type to raise a RuntimeError with the existing and new types
annotate_function_parameter: annotate a function parameter value using the type slot on the function signature instead of annotate
annotate_value_twice: annotate the same fx.Proxy value twice to trigger a RuntimeError about duplicate annotation
